newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani cotton rates steady in selective trade.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani cotton rates steady in selective trade.

text.p: Pakistani cotton rates were steady on Saturday in selective buying by spinners but are likely to fall on Sunday because of high supplies, dealers said.
They said shortage of cash with spinners and a buildup of about two million bales of unsold stocks at ginneries might keep the prices under pressure.
In the kerb market, the NIAB-78 variety was traded at 2,275 rupees ($56.56) per maund (37.32 kg), the dealers said.
